items.title: SIRIUS SPoC network meets as EU enters new era for electronic evidence
items.summary: The 7th SIRIUS Single Point of Contact (SPoC) Network Meeting, organised by Europol’s EU Internet Referral Unit (EU IRU) together with the German Federal Criminal Police Office (Bundeskriminalamt), took place in Berlin on 15-16 September 2026.

items.title: Crypto Tax Bill Clears House Committee After Clarity Act Setback
items.summary: The bill would exempt qualifying crypto fees from gain-or-loss calculations and restrict tax-loss deductions on tokens sold and quickly repurchased.

items.title: Bitcoin Core Software Update Aims for Speed and Security Patches
items.summary: Bitcoin Core 32.0 has entered final testing, bringing faster block checks and changes to how wallets prepare payments.

items.title: Fed Hikes Rates for the First Time Since 2023, Bitcoin Spikes
items.summary: The Federal Reserve delivered the hike Wall Street had almost unanimously priced in.

items.title: CFTC and SEC Double Down on Crypto After Clarity Act Defeat
items.summary: Michael Selig and Paul Atkins pledged to use their agencies’ existing powers to provide crypto regulatory certainty after the Senate failed to advance the bill.

items.title: Hackers Hijack HBO Max’s Reddit Account to Spread Crypto-Stealing Malware
items.summary: Attackers ran 108 malicious ads through the streaming service’s verified account, directing users to fake software downloads.

items.title: Bitcoin ETFs Had Their Worst Day Since June Following Failed Clarity Act Vote
items.summary: Bitcoin, Ethereum, and XRP ETFs shed roughly $593 million combined Tuesday, their heaviest single-day drawdown since June.

items.title: Circle Launches Arc Mainnet With BlackRock, DTCC and Visa as Validators
items.summary: The Layer 1 network’s validator set is permissioned, and Circle has minted 10 billion ARC tokens without committing to publicly launch them.

items.title: FCA Guidance Lands Two Weeks Before UK Crypto Authorization Window Opens
items.summary: Overseas firms serving UK retail customers need authorization too, and nobody trades under the new rules before October 2027.

items.title: Morning Minute: Clarity Act Vote Falls Short as Democrats All Vote ‘No’
items.summary: It should not have come as a surprise given the odds, but crypto majors, alts and memes all sold off anyway in the wake.

items.title: Bitcoin Hovers at $76K as Analysts Argue the Fed Matters More Than Clarity Act
items.summary: With Bitcoin sitting around $76,000, the argument from analysts is that dollar liquidity, not Congress, sets the floor from here.

items.title: UK Backs Money Laundering Crackdown With $676M and 500 New Officers
items.summary: The Home Office names crypto alongside fintech and AI as drivers of a threat the NCA puts at £100 billion a year in the UK.

items.title: Crypto firms get guidance on how the new regime applies
items.summary:
New FCA guidance will help firms understand how the law underpinning the UK's future cryptoasset regime applies to their business. It also sets out which activities may require FCA authorisation.

items.title: Tonkeeper Becomes Keeper as Wallet Adds Bitcoin, Ethereum, and Tron
items.summary: The self-custodial wallet is expanding beyond The Open Network, with support for seven blockchains and more financial products planned.

items.title: Crypto Exchange CoinEx Is Shutting Down After Nine Years, Giving Users Until December to Cash Out
items.summary: The Hong Kong-founded exchange blamed a prolonged crypto winter and rising compliance costs, closing the books on a run that began in December 2017.

items.title: Wall Street Bets on Fed Rate Hike: Here's What It Means for Bitcoin, Bonds and Trump
items.summary: Nearly every major bank now expects the Fed to raise rates for the first time in three years. Markets have mostly priced it in, but the political fallout could run deeper than one hike.

items.title: Coinbase-Backed Crypto Group Warns of Midterms Payback After Clarity Act Fails
items.summary: The Coinbase-backed Stand With Crypto will add senators’ votes to its scorecards as it rallies crypto voters ahead of November’s elections.

items.title: Crypto Reacts: Bitcoin Slides as Clarity Act Fails to Clear Senate Vote
items.summary: The Senate fell short of the 60 votes needed to advance the crypto industry's marquee bill Tuesday. Bitcoin dropped as the no tally mounted, but the move stopped well short of panic.

items.title: Clarity Act Stalls in Senate as Crypto Bill Fails to Clear Key Vote
items.summary: The crypto market structure bill failed to receive enough votes to advance in the Senate.

items.title: Robinhood Engineers Charged With Fraud Over Alleged Crypto Listing Trades
items.summary: Two employees allegedly earned more than $50,000 each by trading Hyperliquid perpetual futures before Robinhood announced new token listings.
